hero.title: How Pomelos was born.
hero.description: Two friends from two opposite cultures, and one shared belief: products should be made to last.

story.title: East meets West.
paragraphs: We are two friends coming from two opposite cultures, one from the East and one from the West.

One of us grew up in a culture with a strong appreciation for second-hand goods, vintage pieces and products with enduring quality and character. The other grew up in a culture that values newness and fast fashion, where trends change rapidly and products are designed around shorter consumption cycles.
We miss a time when products were made to last, rather than being replaced every year or even every few months.
story.quote: I miss that massage machine my grandpa bought from a Japanese brand 20 years ago. It still works perfectly today. If I spent the same amount of money now, I would not get the same quality.
story.quoteCaption: One of the founders of Pomelos
story.closing: This is why Pomelos was born.
story.imageAlt: Taipei skyline with Taipei 101 at night

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pomelos ("we", "us") collects, uses and protects personal information when you use this website. We collect as little personal information as possible.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: Contact form: when you submit the contact form we collect your name, business email, company name (optional), country, the service you are interested in and your project details.
Email: when you email us directly, we receive the information you choose to include.
Technical data: our servers and security providers process your IP address and basic request information to deliver the site, prevent abuse and limit spam. This data is not used for marketing.
We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: How we use your information
body: To reply to your enquiry and discuss your project.
To protect the website against spam and abuse.
To comply with legal obligations.
